Reports.Name: Databases
Reports.Query: SELECT name AS DatabaseName, create_date AS CreatedOn FROM sys.databases WHERE create_date >= @StartDate

Reports.Name: Tables
Reports.Query: SELECT TOP (@TopCount) name AS TableName, create_date AS CreatedOn FROM sys.objects WHERE type = 'U' AND name LIKE '%' + @SearchText + '%' AND create_date >= @StartDate ORDER BY CASE WHEN @SortOrder = 'asc' THEN create_date END ASC, CASE WHEN @SortOrder = 'desc' THEN create_date END DESC
